title: After Hours · space after the show

brief.destination: HTML review draft, later native editable PowerPoint after approval
brief.voice: Student club proposer, direct and inviting

creative_brief.tension: The festival ends on stage, but the supplied idea is to keep creativity going in a making space.
creative_brief.concept: A night-time printshop poster: oversized AFTER HOURS typography opens into a proposed stay-and-make experience, with acid-yellow light on a dark stage.
candidates: Photographic night diary: rejected because no rights-cleared photos exist
Sponsor logo wall: rejected because no partners or rights are supplied
Printshop poster and experience threshold: selected; all visuals can be native text and shapes
creative_brief.grammar: Black, warm paper and acid yellow; Arial; large left-set type; thin rules; one outline circle as conceptual spotlight, never documentary evidence.
creative_brief.substantive_test: The same visual grammar explains the making space, opt-in workshop and support ask without invented attendance or ROI.
creative_brief.fidelity: Native text/rules/circles feasible; no automatic custom HTML to PPTX conversion.

THE SPACE WE WANT TO MAKE

Let the night keep making.

notes.say: The relationship is the point of this composition: after the performance, there can be a place to make something. The exact venue and programme still need agreement. The arrow-free layout proposes an experience sequence, not a measured audience journey.
